field_semantics: Use only original Security/Shares/Value rows within the first SOXX common-stock section. Disclosed USD fair value divided by sum of disclosed common-stock USD fair values yields a reported-basket proxy weight, not daily index or ETF weight.
fixed_parser: Parse direct HTML table rows. A security row must have a nonempty security-name cell and separate positive integer shares and USD fair-value cells. Exclude sector headings, subtotals, total rows, footnote rows, cash funds and securities lending collateral. Retain unparsed rows and fail if ambiguous.
checks: all shares and values positive finite integers
sum of parsed fair values equals the printed TOTAL COMMON STOCKS to within one USD
no duplicate security names and no current-constituent substitution
stop: If row parsing or total closure fails, preserve the exact failure; do not infer missing members, change the parse rule after seeing a target outcome, or use the single vintage as a full Stage1 feature.
scientific_boundary: One original delayed disclosed basket proves parser feasibility only. Full predecision filing coverage and publication clocks across 2011-2022, same-series transition, and a frozen Stage1 information test remain required before any 0bp account.
